topic: kido data query failure on empty facility list
summary_markdown:
A discussion arose regarding the instability of the `ml-api` service, which is restarting frequently. The core issue discussed was a SQL query failure when the list of facilities (`facility_ids`) passed to it is empty.

Someone noted that the process likely first applies filters (e.g., visible segments) before executing the Kido data query. They plan to fix the logic to handle cases where zero facilities are provided for the query.
decisions: The issue of the `ml-api` restarting due to empty facility lists will be addressed.
action_items: Someone will review and fix the code to correctly handle queries when no facility IDs are available.
